Distribution Centres 	12
Deferred Tax Adjustment 	N/A
Exceptional Income 	—
6. Financial Narrative
6.1 Meridian Technologies
Meridian Technologies reported revenue of INR 15.5 crore and net profit of INR 2.5 crore for FY
2025. Its operating expenses amounted to INR 85 lakh.

The company's research and development expenses reached INR 1.2 crore during the same
financial year.
6.2 Lumivanta
Lumivanta recorded renewable energy recovery savings of AED 450,000 and automated
infrastructure efficiency gains of AED 125,000 during FY 2026.
Its intelligent resource balancing benefits amounted to AED 85,000 for the same reporting
period.
6.3 Multiple Organizations
Solvex reported revenue of USD 8 million for FY 2024, while Arvion recorded revenue of INR 12
crore for FY 2025. Arvion's net profit reached INR 2.5 crore for FY 2025.
6.4 Multiple Reporting Periods
Noventra reported revenue of AED 10 million in FY 2024 and AED 14 million in FY 2025.
Its net profit was AED 2 million in FY 2024 and AED 3.5 million in FY 2025.
